
A document has one owner (defaults to the creator, or `lode doc add --owner`) and a set of reviewers (`lode doc set reviewers <actor>... <ref>`, read with `lode doc reviewers <ref>`). The owner submits and lands revisions. A document of any kind, plan included, is not accepted until every assigned reviewer has approved the current version and no approval on that version is still open. Once a submitted version meets that gate, it is accepted (WL-REQ-1659). Ownership transfers through `POST /api/v1/docs/{id}/owner` (`lode doc transfer <ref>... --to <actor>`, or every document one actor owns with `--from <actor>`), by the current owner or an admin, emitting `doc.owner_changed`. A transfer to the current owner is a legal no-op and still emits.
